authority_contract.csw05: pre-authoritative planning only; planned revelations/clue coverage/routes never become Adventure/Campaign/runtime truth without explicit owning-domain handoff
authority_contract.a9: runtime clue/discovery, observation, claim, evidence, hypothesis, conclusion, Player-knowledge and hidden-information authority remains A9
authority_contract.privacy: authorization filtering precedes counts, search, graph/layout, grouping, diagnostics, export, notifications, microcopy and AI context
authority_contract.truth: objective truth, observations, claims, evidence references, hypotheses, conclusions and Player knowledge remain distinct
authority_contract.misdirection: misleading-but-fair design may support plausible interpretations but cannot rewrite objective truth or fabricate protected facts
authority_contract.failure: fail-forward changes route/cost/timing/certainty without automatic discovery or forced solution
authority_contract.ai: optional proposal-only; no solve/reveal/truth mutation authority
